job.job_description:
About the Job What You'll Do

* Design and build conversational flows for chat and voice agents that feel natural, not scripted.

* Improve voice quality and naturalness of AI voice agents (TTS tuning, SSML, pronunciation handling for mixed-language conversations).
* Build and refine intent detection, lead scoring signals, and conversation intelligence features.
* Integrate LLMs with external tools and systems (CRM, ticketing, calendar, ecommerce platforms) via agentic tool-calling.
* Continuously test, evaluate, and improve agent responses using real conversation data.
* Collaborate closely with product and engineering to ship features from prototype to production.
* Own quality and reliability of AI outputs
reducing hallucinations, improving accuracy, and handling edge cases gracefully.

What Were Looking For * 1-2 years of experience building AI/ML or LLM-based applications, with specific hands-on exposure to conversational AI and/or voice AI systems.

* Strong Python skills and comfort working directly with LLM APIs.
* A builder
s mindset
comfortable moving from research/prototyping to production-ready systems.
* Experience debugging and improving live conversational systems (not just building demos).
* Bonus: Previous experience working on a chatbot, voice bot, or AI customer-facing agent product.
